message.content: It started about eight days ago as mild pain in the upper left side of my belly. It was treated like stomach flu, but it didn’t get better and has been getting worse, and now I’m also nauseated and vomiting. I don’t remember if it was sudden or gradual or what makes it better or worse. I’m not sure how to describe the pain or rate it on a 0–10 scale, and I haven’t noticed it going to my back or shoulder.
